The current provisional bridge-support amount for Tidal Exchange is 2,020 USD, revised from the earlier 1,960 USD provisional amount, to be shared only within the core chain and not disclosed outside it; this private bridge-support amount must not be confused with the public Tidal Leaders materials pool of 2,040 USD.
